_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'SCOPE MANAGEMENT PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.02.01.

f01_Scope_Planning_Approach.label: Scope Planning Approach
f01_Scope_Planning_Approach.guidance: Overall approach for developing the detailed project scope statement and requirements.

f02_Roles_and_Responsibilities_Scope.label: Roles and Responsibilities (Scope)
f02_Roles_and_Responsibilities_Scope.guidance: Key roles responsible for defining, decomposing, and validating project scope.

f03_Scope_Statement_Preparation_Steps.label: Scope Statement Preparation Steps
f03_Scope_Statement_Preparation_Steps.guidance: Sequence of analytical activities used to author and validate the scope statement.

f04_WBS_Decomposition_Methodology.label: WBS Decomposition Methodology
f04_WBS_Decomposition_Methodology.guidance: Techniques used to break down major deliverables into verifiable work packages.

f05_WBS_Level_of_Detail.label: WBS Level of Detail
f05_WBS_Level_of_Detail.guidance: Guidelines governing the granularity and completion criteria for lowest-level WBS nodes.

f06_WBS_Identification_Scheme.label: WBS Identification Scheme
f06_WBS_Identification_Scheme.guidance: Numbering and hierarchical coding structure applied across the work breakdown structure.

f07_WBS_Dictionary_Development.label: WBS Dictionary Development
f07_WBS_Dictionary_Development.guidance: Standard procedure for authoring detailed work package definitions and milestones.

f08_Scope_Baseline_Approval_and_Maintena.label: Scope Baseline Approval and Maintenance
f08_Scope_Baseline_Approval_and_Maintena.guidance: Formal protocols for baseline sign-off, version control, and maintenance updates.

f09_Deliverable_Verification_Process.label: Deliverable Verification Process
f09_Deliverable_Verification_Process.guidance: Quality control and technical verification procedures prior to client inspection.

f10_Formal_Acceptance_Criteria_and_Sign_.label: Formal Acceptance Criteria and Sign-off
f10_Formal_Acceptance_Criteria_and_Sign_.guidance: Step-by-step procedure for obtaining formal customer or sponsor acceptance.

f11_Scope_Change_Control_Integration.label: Scope Change Control Integration
f11_Scope_Change_Control_Integration.guidance: Workflow connecting scope variance identification to formal change request processing.

f12_Scope_and_Requirements_Traceability_.label: Scope and Requirements Traceability Integration
f12_Scope_and_Requirements_Traceability_.guidance: Alignment mechanism linking requirements traceability to scope deliverables.
